limits: Local complex QM, bilinear operational preparation/testing, local tomography, product positivity and calibrated reversible preservation are theorem parameters, not derived from primitive difference.
The shift theorem assumes n<=m and m!=0. For positive subsystem dimensions, name the smaller subsystem as the control. It does not assert the same orbit with a larger control and smaller target.
The formal finite-frame calibration theorem accepts arbitrary supplied local Hermitian bases. The displayed positive projector-basis construction remains prose.

Generated effects, saturated binary effects, POVMs and no-signalling remain prose corollaries under their stated assumptions; no full channel classification or robust finite-statistics calibration is proved.
This is a fresh seven-module Lean replay and focused Python/DAG/atlas verification, not a full repository lake, Python or Rust build.
